title: Is It Bad to Work All the Time? Cross-Cultural Evaluation of Social Norm Biases in GPT-4
reasoning: The paper specifically evaluates and benchmarks social and moral norms (Rules of Thumb) across different cultures. It includes assessments of religiously and morally grounded statements, such as 'It is commendable to marry within your own religion' and 'It is immoral to reveal the body in public', and focuses on the model's understanding of cultural values, norms, and morals.
